# AAC-LC Vector Corpus

These ADTS AAC-LC fixtures are generated by `scripts/gen_testvectors.sh`.

`manifest.json` contains input SHA-256 values and byte-exact little-endian S16
PCM SHA-256 values from the pinned FAAD2 `2.11.2` oracle. The Go tests decode
these files through one-shot, streaming, frame-by-frame, and raw-payload APIs.
